title: How we cut our short-term rental tech stack: what ProhostAI replaces, and what it doesn't
summary: Twelve tool categories hosts usually stack, from PMS to team chat. ProhostAI replaces ten of them. Here's which, how to switch in order, and the two to keep.
body_markdown:
**A typical short-term rental stack has a tool for every job: a PMS, a messaging tool, a pricing tool, a lock app, a cleaning scheduler, a review tool, a guidebook, a phone line, and often a direct booking site and a team chat on top. Each one is reasonable on its own. Together they mean ten logins, ten bills, and the same guest's details copied into five places. Here's the list of tool categories hosts usually stack, which ones ProhostAI replaces, and, just as important, which ones it doesn't.**


We make ProhostAI, so this is our product's view of the stack. We've tried to be exact about what it does and doesn't do, and we link to the feature page for each claim so you can check it.
